T2. Forward-looking reporting short-term risks (next few weeks/months) [YES] — Friday NFP, August CPI/PPI next week, Sep 15–16 Fed meeting
T3. Forward-looking reporting long-term risks (next quarters/years) [NO]

**Synopsis:**
Gold surged 2.3% on Thursday after Fed Governor Waller signaled openness to holding rates steady if inflation continues to cool. This shifted market rate-hike odds for the September 15–16 FOMC meeting from ~62% to ~54%. Falling Treasury yields and a weaker dollar amplified bullion's rally. Precious metals broadly gained (silver +2.8%, platinum +4.2%, palladium +5.9%). Markets are now focused on Friday's NFP and next week's CPI/PPI as key decision inputs for the Fed.
